claim_ceiling: Typed-record, digest-consistency and time-window checks only. No semantic correctness, physical safety, controller, actuator or road-safety result is claimed.
core_hypothesis: Short-lived action-evidence envelopes, revalidated at execution time, can prevent time-of-check/time-of-use failures under sensor and compute perturbations while allowing explicitly bounded degraded action profiles.

paradigm_shift.from: A model output is treated as actionable when inference completes.
paradigm_shift.to: An action is a short-lived proposal bound to an exact evidence bundle, explicit evidence profile and execution-time revalidation.
paradigm_shift.differentiator: The authorization expires at the earliest proposal, policy or required-evidence deadline; any evidence, policy or action mutation invalidates the old envelope.

profiles.description: Normal action profile with caller-defined evidence recency, delivery/processing bounds, health requirements, inter-sensor skew and action set.
Explicit, narrower action set with caller-defined degraded evidence tolerances. It cannot be inferred or invented by the gate.

experiment_tracks.runs: valid nominal/restricted, each violation boundary and negative control
mutate sensor payload, add a new observation, change policy, mutate action or expire envelope between authorization and execution
reproduce the published frame-drop, partial-view, localization, speed-noise and latency settings using matched Bench2Drive agents
critical evidence deletion vs irrelevant sensor/input ablation, matched policy and task
fixed-size and scaled evidence bundles on a named CPU and exact build

invalid_authorization_rate.formula: invalid proposals authorized / invalid proposals submitted

stale_execution_acceptance_rate.formula: expired or superseded envelopes accepted / invalidated envelopes submitted

bundle_mismatch_acceptance_rate.formula: executions accepted with evidence digest different from the proposal source digest / mismatch attempts

false_restriction_rate.formula: nominally valid proposals sent to restricted/fallback / nominally valid proposals

fallback_required_rate.formula: proposals requiring declared fallback / all proposals

recovery_lead_time_us.formula: execution deadline minus first evidence-invalid time when the gate rejects

evidence_dependence.formula: paired change under decision-critical evidence deletion contrasted with irrelevant-input ablation

prospective_targets.note: The 1 ms p99 target is a research target on a pinned reference CPU, not a measured result or safety requirement. False-restriction and capability-retention targets must be frozen only after baseline reproduction.

negative_controls: valid evidence but wrong proposal source digest
new camera frame arrives after authorization
same payload with different calibration digest
sequence increases while capture timestamp regresses
delivery timestamp appears current while capture timestamp is stale
restricted profile permits routine actions but not overtaking
envelope expiry is extended and commitment recomputed by an untrusted caller
policy profile changes between decision and execution
irrelevant sensor deletion is confused with decision-critical deletion
